task.description: Produce a Type E close-out design for GH-482 / ISS-0150. Re-measure test-integration-svc under fresh conditions, then define exit-0 close-out and nonzero forwarding paths without proposing source changes absent a newly measured root cause.
acceptance_criteria: Design classifies the work under templates/lego-catalog.md
Design specifies a full test-integration-svc run on the feature branch with BPM_TEST_DB_URL targeting a fresh db_test
Design defines the exit-0 close-out path: release decision, ISS-0150 RESOLVED, no source change
Design defines per-remaining-block triage for exit-nonzero results, separating origin/main pre-existing failures from branch-new failures
Design documents environment sensitivity, parallel-workspace interference, and port conflicts
No source-code change is proposed unless re-measurement establishes a new root cause

result.summary: Produced the Type E close-out design for GH-482 / ISS-0150. It specifies fresh-database re-measurement, exit-0 release and issue close-out, evidence-based forwarding for non-zero residuals, and safeguards against environment, parallel-workspace, and port-conflict interference. No source-code change is proposed absent a newly verified root cause.

issues.description: Design lint reports three E030 warnings for intentional references to the canonical public.schema_migrations ledger; no BLOCKER or MAJOR findings.
